remarks: An exceptional and unique opportunity awaits - rarely, if ever, does land of this quality and location come to market! Dream, create and escape to your sanctuary with this breathtaking and flat 7.62-acre property nestled in coveted Darien, CT. Boasting 2.74 buildable acres, this one-of-a-kind parcel offers an unparalleled canvas to create your custom masterpiece. Imagine waking up to serene and panoramic vistas, entertaining like no one else can, and multiple generations playing in the natural and private landscape. Whether you envision a family compound, a minimalist retreat or a timeless country estate, this property offers endless possibilities to bring your architectural dreams to life. Located in one of Connecticut's most sought-after enclaves, you'll enjoy the perfect balance of tranquility and accessibility - one hour from Manhattan, and just minutes from the vibrant towns of Darien and New Canaan, top-rated schools, country and riding clubs, town beaches and the sparkling Long Island Sound. This is more than a property; it's an invitation to create your masterpiece and provide the landscape to build memories with family and friends. Don't just build a house - create a legacy on this extraordinary land. Your dream starts here.
